name: partsforagents CAD advice
tagline: Free manufacturing guidance for agents preparing exact-CAD prototype requests.
description:
Free, sourced guidance on fits, materials and manufacturing for agents working on CAD. This public connection exposes three read tools for advice, service status and production capabilities, plus a feedback-submission tool that writes only with explicit consent. It does not upload CAD or place orders.

For an owner-authorized design, the separate [CAD-to-print walkthrough](https://partsforagents.com/guides/cad-to-print) explains how to preserve the exact file, units, quantity and specification in a nonbinding manufacturing request. No upfront payment is required; an exact reviewed offer and payment instructions come later. A request is not a confirmed order or reserved capacity.

install.notes: No account, API key or CAD upload is needed for the three read tools. Start with get_manufacturing_advice. submit_agent_feedback is a separate consented write; do not include private CAD, personal information or secrets. Private CAD intake and job tracking require the separately documented authenticated workflow.
